title: Haan wo hai fatima
body:
Haan wo hai fatima
Sayyada, tahera, raaziya, marziya..(2)

Haan wo hai fatima..(4)
Naazil dil e rasool par..(2) jo mojiza hua
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(4)
1. Charkha jo kaatti hai to burti hai aasma
<<DIVIDER>>
chakki jo peesti hai to chalta hai ye jahaan
yu haath kibriya ka batati hai jo sada
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
2. Zehra ki azmato ko kya samjhega ye bashar
<<DIVIDER>>
hasnain baagh e khuld ke sardaar hai magar
jannat hasan husain ki..(2) hai jiske zere paa
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
3. Qanoon e kibriya hai ye is kayenat me
<<DIVIDER>>
shauhar ka rizq likha hai zawja ke haath me
tehreer jiske haath me hai rizq e murtuza
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
4. Tanzeem e kaynat me haider ke saath thi
<<DIVIDER>>
mitti khameer hazrat e adam se jo bachi
jisne usi khameer se..(2) hawwa ko di jila
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
5. Masoom ki hadees hai sab ko hai ye khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
chawda naqab e noor hai khaliq ke noor par
pehla naqab jo hai rukhe kirdigaar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
6. Haq to yahi tha hota ta'arruf rasool se
<<DIVIDER>>
rishte magar khuda ne ginaye batool se
jiske liye nizam e..(2) mashiyat badal gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
7. Ismat ka rabb ne paas yu rakha kitab me
<<DIVIDER>>
aayat me bhi zikr kiya to hijaab me
qur'an me jiska naam bhi khul kar nahi liya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
8. Mangwa ke do libaase falak ikhteyaar se
<<DIVIDER>>
jisne hasan husain ki khwahish ke waaste
aayaat lane wale ko..(2) darzi bana liya
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
9. Akbar ko noor e aale mohd ki hai qasam
<<DIVIDER>>
duniya me meer koi nahi usse mohtaram
wo jiske ehteraam me uth te ho mustafa
<<DIVIDER>>
Haan wo hai fatima..(3)
author: Mir Hassan Mir
